privateKey.description: This is for the integration key you obtained above and can also be created on the <https://admindemo.docusign.com/authenticate?goTo=appsAndKeys|Apps and Keys> page. You only need the private key, and it can only be copied once. Make sure to retain it for your records.

impersonatedUserId.description: This is a GUID identifying the Docusign user that you will be impersonating with the access token. Your own User ID can be found at the top of the<https://admindemo.docusign.com/authenticate?goTo=appsAndKeys|Apps and Keys> page

scopes.description: Comma-separated list of scopes. These represent the OAuth scopes (permissions) that are being requested. For eSignature REST API methods, use the signature scope. The impersonation scope is implied by the JWT Grant operation and does not need to be included. If the access token will be used for other Docusign APIs, additional scopes may be required; see each API's <https://developers.docusign.com/docs/esign-rest-api/esign101/auth/|authentication> requirements

listEnvelopes.name: listEnvelopes
listEnvelopes.description: Find and list signing requests with optional filters like status, date range, or keyword.

aiMetadata.description: Lists DocuSign envelopes (signing requests) for an account, auto-paginating through all results. Filters are optional: with no filters it returns all envelopes, otherwise it narrows by status, sender/received date range, or a search keyword. Use to find envelopes by criteria before acting on them; requires the account ID. Read-only and idempotent.

getEnvelope.name: getEnvelope
getEnvelope.description: Look up the full details of a signing request — status, recipients, and dates — using its ID.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves the full details of a single DocuSign envelope (signing request) by its envelope ID, including status, recipients, and dates. Use when you already know the envelope ID and need its current state; requires the account ID and envelope ID. Read-only and idempotent.

getDocument.name: getDocument
getDocument.description: Download a document (or all documents) from a signing request as a file.

documentId.description:
The ID of the document to retrieve. Alternatively, you can use one of the following special keywords:

combined: Retrieves all of the documents as a single PDF file. When the query parameter certificate is true, the certificate of completion is included in the PDF file. When the query parameter certificate is false, the certificate of completion is not included in the PDF file.
archive: Retrieves a ZIP archive that contains all of the PDF documents and the certificate of completion.
certificate: Retrieves only the certificate of completion as a PDF file.
portfolio: Retrieves the envelope documents as a PDF portfolio.

aiMetadata.description: Downloads a document from a DocuSign envelope (signing request) as a file, given the account, envelope, and document ID. The document ID accepts a specific document number or special keywords — combined (all documents as one PDF), archive (a ZIP of all PDFs plus the certificate), certificate (only the completion certificate), or portfolio. Use to fetch signed or in-progress document files. Read-only and idempotent.

createAndSendEnvelope.name: createAndSendEnvelope
createAndSendEnvelope.description: Upload a document and send it to one or more people to sign via DocuSign.

emailSubject.description: Subject line of the email sent to all recipients.

emailBlurb.description: Optional message body included in the signing request email.

documents.description: Documents to include in the envelope.

file.description: PDF or other supported document to upload.

fileExtension.description: Extension without dot, e.g. pdf, docx.

signers.description: Recipients who must sign the envelope.

routingOrder.description: Order in which this signer receives the envelope. Lower numbers go first.

carbonCopies.description: Recipients who receive a copy of the completed envelope but do not sign.

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new DocuSign envelope from one or more uploaded documents and a set of signers (plus optional carbon-copy recipients), then either sends it immediately for signing or saves it as a draft depending on the chosen action. Use to start a new signing request; requires the account ID, an email subject, at least one document, and at least one signer. Not idempotent — each call creates and (unless saved as draft) sends a new envelope.

updateEnvelope.name: updateEnvelope
updateEnvelope.description: Send a draft, cancel, resend reminders, or edit the subject line on a signing request.

voidedReason.description: Required when operation is "Void Envelope". Explain why the envelope is being voided.

emailSubject.description: Required when operation is "Update Email Subject / Message". New subject line for the signing email.

emailBlurb.description: Used when operation is "Update Email Subject / Message". New body text for the signing email.

aiMetadata.description: Modifies an existing DocuSign envelope by its ID, performing one of several operations selected via the operation input: send a draft (status to sent), void/cancel an in-progress envelope (requires a void reason), resend the signing email to recipients, or update the email subject and message. Use to advance, cancel, or amend an envelope you already created; requires the account ID and envelope ID. Not idempotent — operations like resend and void mutate state or send new emails on each call.

listTemplates.name: listTemplates
listTemplates.description: Search for reusable signing templates by name.

templateName.description: Full or partial name of the template to search for.

aiMetadata.description: Searches an account for reusable DocuSign envelope templates whose name matches the given full or partial template name, auto-paginating through all matches. Use to discover a template ID or confirm a template exists before building an envelope from it; requires the account ID and a template name to search for. Read-only and idempotent.

findEnvelopeRecipients.name: findEnvelopeRecipients
findEnvelopeRecipients.displayName: Get People on a Signing Request
findEnvelopeRecipients.description: Get the full list of people on a signing request — signers, viewers, and anyone copied.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves the list of all recipients on a DocuSign envelope by its ID — signers, carbon copies, certified deliveries, and other roles — along with their status. Use when you need to know who is on a signing request and where each person stands; requires the account ID and envelope ID. Read-only and idempotent.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

envelopeCreated.name: envelopeCreated
envelopeCreated.description: Triggers when a new signing request (envelope) is created in DocuSign — whether sent immediately or saved as a draft.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new DocuSign envelope (signing request) is created on the account, whether it was sent immediately or saved as a draft. Represents the earliest point in an envelope lifecycle, before any recipient action.

envelopeSent.name: envelopeSent
envelopeSent.description: Triggers when a signing request is emailed out to recipients for the first time.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a DocuSign envelope is sent out to its recipients for the first time, transitioning from draft to active. Represents the envelope entering the signing process for the whole recipient set.

envelopeDelivered.name: envelopeDelivered
envelopeDelivered.description: Triggers when every recipient has opened and viewed the signing request at least once.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when every recipient on a DocuSign envelope has opened and viewed it at least once. Represents confirmed delivery to the full recipient set, but not yet signing completion.

envelopeCompleted.name: envelopeCompleted
envelopeCompleted.description: Triggers when everyone has completed their signature and the document is fully signed.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when all recipients on a DocuSign envelope have completed their signatures and the envelope is fully signed. Represents successful end-to-end completion of a signing request.

envelopeDeclined.name: envelopeDeclined
envelopeDeclined.description: Triggers when a recipient refuses to sign, stopping the signing process.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a recipient declines to sign a DocuSign envelope, which halts the signing process for the whole envelope. Represents a terminal failure of the signing request due to refusal.

envelopeVoided.name: envelopeVoided
envelopeVoided.description: Triggers when the sender cancels an in-progress signing request before everyone has signed.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when the sender voids (cancels) an in-progress DocuSign envelope before all recipients have signed. Represents the sender-initiated termination of a signing request, as opposed to a recipient declining.

recipientSent.name: recipientSent
recipientSent.description: Triggers when DocuSign sends the signing email to a specific person.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when DocuSign sends the signing email to a specific recipient on an envelope. Represents a per-recipient event (the payload identifies the recipient), useful for tracking an individual signer rather than the whole envelope.

recipientDelivered.name: recipientDelivered
recipientDelivered.description: Triggers when a specific person opens and views the signing request.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a specific recipient opens and views a DocuSign envelope. Represents per-recipient delivery confirmation (the payload identifies the recipient), as opposed to the envelope-level all-recipients-delivered event.

recipientCompleted.name: recipientCompleted
recipientCompleted.description: Triggers when a specific person completes their signature on the document.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a specific recipient completes their signature on a DocuSign envelope. Represents one signer finishing (the payload identifies the recipient); the envelope may still be awaiting other recipients, unlike the envelope-completed event.

recipientDeclined.name: recipientDeclined
recipientDeclined.description: Triggers when a specific person refuses to sign the document.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a specific recipient declines to sign a DocuSign envelope. Represents a per-recipient refusal (the payload identifies the recipient), which typically halts the envelope.

recipientAuthenticationFailed.name: recipientAuthenticationFailed
recipientAuthenticationFailed.description: Triggers when a recipient fails the identity verification step before signing.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a specific recipient fails the identity verification (authentication) step required before signing a DocuSign envelope. Represents a per-recipient access/security event (the payload identifies the recipient), useful for flagging failed signing attempts.

certificaat: Retriveert alleen het certificaat van de voltooiing als een PDF-bestand.
portfolio: Retriveert de envelop documenten als een PDF-portfolio.

de.Comma-separated list of scopes. These re: Kommaseparierte Liste von Bereichen. Diese stellen die OAuth scopes (Berechtigungen) dar, die angefordert werden. de.The ID of the document to retrieve. Alte:
Die ID des abzuholenden Dokuments. Alternativ können Sie eines der folgenden speziellen Schlüsselwörter verwenden:

kombiniert: Ruft alle Dokumente als eine einzelne PDF-Datei ab. Wenn das Abfrageparameter Zertifikat wahr ist, wird das Vervollständigungszertifikat in der PDF-Datei enthalten. Wenn das Abfrageparameter Zertifikat falsch ist, ist das Vervollständigungszertifikat nicht in der PDF-Datei enthalten.
Archiv: Ruft ein ZIP-Archiv ab, das alle PDF-Dokumente und das Vervollständigungszertifikat enthält.
Zertifikat: Ruft nur das Abschlusszertifikat als PDF-Datei ab.
Portfolio: Ruft die Umschlagdokumente als PDF-Portfolio ab.

de.Required when operation is \"Update Emai: Wird benötigt, wenn der Vorgang "Update Email Betreff / Nachricht" ist. Neue Betreffzeile für die Signatur-E-Mail.
de.Used when operation is \"Update Email Su: Wird verwendet, wenn der Vorgang "Update E-Mail Betreff / Nachricht" ist. Neuer Text für die Signatur-E-Mail.

de.Triggers when a new signing request (env: Wird ausgelöst, wenn in DocuSign eine neue Signaturanfrage (Umschlag) erstellt wird — ob sofort gesendet oder als Entwurf gespeichert.
de.Triggers when a signing request is email: Wird ausgelöst, wenn eine Signaturanfrage zum ersten Mal an die Empfänger gesendet wird.
de.Triggers when every recipient has opened: Wird ausgelöst, wenn jeder Empfänger geöffnet hat und mindestens einmal die Signaturanfrage angeschaut hat.
de.Triggers when everyone has completed the: Trigger wenn jeder seine Unterschrift abgeschlossen hat und das Dokument vollständig unterschrieben ist.
de.Triggers when a recipient refuses to sig: Wird ausgelöst, wenn ein Empfänger sich weigert, zu signieren, was den Signaturprozess stoppt.
de.Triggers when the sender cancels an in-p: Wird ausgelöst, wenn der Absender eine laufende Signaturanfrage annulliert, bevor alle signiert haben.
de.Triggers when DocuSign sends the signing: Wird ausgelöst, wenn DocuSign die Signatur-E-Mail an eine bestimmte Person sendet.
de.Triggers when a specific person opens an: Wird ausgelöst, wenn sich eine bestimmte Person öffnet und die Signaturanfrage anzeigt.
de.Triggers when a specific person complete: Löst aus, wenn eine bestimmte Person ihre Unterschrift auf dem Dokument abschließt.
de.Triggers when a specific person refuses: Wird ausgelöst, wenn eine bestimmte Person das Dokument nicht unterschreiben will.
de.Triggers when a recipient fails the iden: Wird ausgelöst, wenn ein Empfänger den Identitätsüberprüfungsschritt vor der Unterschrift fehlschlägt.

fr.Upload a document and send it to one or: Téléchargez un document et envoyez-le à une ou plusieurs personnes à signer via DocuSign.
fr.Send a draft, cancel, resend reminders,: Envoyer un brouillon, annuler, renvoyer des rappels ou modifier le sujet sur une demande de signature.
fr.Search for reusable signing templates by: Rechercher des modèles de signature réutilisables par nom.
fr.Get the full list of people on a signing: Obtenez la liste complète des personnes sur une demande de signature — signataires, téléspectateurs et toute personne copiée.
fr.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Passez un appel API personnalisé à un point de terminaison spécifique
fr.The ID of the document to retrieve. Alte:
L'ID du document à récupérer. Vous pouvez également utiliser l'un des mots-clés spéciaux suivants :

combiné : Récupère tous les documents en un seul fichier PDF. Lorsque le certificat de paramètre de requête est vrai, le certificat de complétion est inclus dans le fichier PDF. Lorsque le certificat de paramètre de requête est faux, le certificat de complétion n'est pas inclus dans le fichier PDF.
archive : Récupère une archive ZIP qui contient tous les documents PDF et le certificat de complétude.
certificat : Récupère uniquement le certificat de complétion en tant que fichier PDF.
portefeuille : Récupère les enveloppes en tant que portefeuille PDF.
fr.Subject line of the email sent to all re: Sujet de l'e-mail envoyé à tous les destinataires.
fr.Optional message body included in the si: Corps du message facultatif inclus dans l'e-mail de la demande de signature.
fr.Recipients who receive a copy of the com: Destinataires qui reçoivent une copie de l'enveloppe remplie mais qui ne signent pas.
fr.Required when operation is \"Void Envelo: Requis lorsque l'opération est « Enveloppe du Néant ». Expliquez pourquoi l'enveloppe est annulée.
fr.Required when operation is \"Update Emai: Requis lorsque l'opération est "Mettre à jour l'objet de l'e-mail / Message". Nouvelle ligne de sujet pour l'e-mail de signature.
fr.Used when operation is \"Update Email Su: Utilisé lorsque l'opération est "Mettre à jour l'objet de l'e-mail / Message". Nouveau corps de texte pour l'e-mail de signature.
fr.Full or partial name of the template to: Nom complet ou partiel du modèle à rechercher.
fr.Authorization headers are injected autom: Les en-têtes d'autorisation sont injectés automatiquement à partir de votre connexion.
Activer pour les fichiers comme les PDFs, les images, etc.
fr.Update Email Subject / Message: Mettre à jour le sujet de l'e-mail / message
fr.HEAD: HEAD
fr.Signing Request Opened by All: Demande de signature ouverte par tous
fr.Signing Email Sent to Person: Email de signature envoyé à la personne
fr.Person Failed Identity Check: Échec de la vérification d'identité de la personne
fr.Triggers when a new signing request (env: Déclenche lorsqu'une nouvelle demande de signature (enveloppe) est créée dans DocuSign — qu'elle soit envoyée immédiatement ou enregistrée comme brouillon.
fr.Triggers when a signing request is email: Déclenche quand une demande de signature est envoyée aux destinataires pour la première fois.
fr.Triggers when every recipient has opened: Déclenche lorsque chaque destinataire a ouvert et consulté la demande de signature au moins une fois.
fr.Triggers when everyone has completed the: Déclenche quand tout le monde a terminé sa signature et que le document est entièrement signé.
fr.Triggers when a recipient refuses to sig: Déclenche lorsqu'un destinataire refuse de signer, arrêtant le processus de signature.
fr.Triggers when the sender cancels an in-p: Déclenche lorsque l'expéditeur annule une demande de signature en cours avant que tout le monde ne soit signé.
fr.Triggers when DocuSign sends the signing: Déclenche lorsque DocuSign envoie l'e-mail de signature à une personne spécifique.
fr.Triggers when a specific person opens an: Déclenche quand une personne spécifique s'ouvre et voit la demande de signature.
fr.Triggers when a specific person complete: Déclenche quand une personne précise complète sa signature sur le document.
fr.Triggers when a specific person refuses: Déclenche quand une personne spécifique refuse de signer le document.
fr.Triggers when a recipient fails the iden: Déclenche lorsqu'un destinataire échoue à l'étape de vérification de l'identité avant la signature.

Para los métodos de eSignature REST API, utilice el ámbito de la firma. El ámbito de suplantación está implícito en la operación JWT Subant y no necesita ser incluido. es.Get Signing Request Details: Obtener detalles de Solicitud de Firma
es.Download Document from Signing Request: Descargar documento desde la solicitud de firma

es.Look up the full details of a signing re: Busque los detalles completos de una solicitud de firma - estado, destinatario y fechas - usando su DNI.

es.Upload a document and send it to one or: Sube un documento y envíalo a una o más personas para firmar a través de DocuSign.
es.Send a draft, cancel, resend reminders,: Enviar un borrador, cancelar, reenviar recordatorios, o editar la línea del asunto en una solicitud de firma.
es.Search for reusable signing templates by: Buscar plantillas de firma reutilizables por nombre.
es.Get the full list of people on a signing: Obtén la lista completa de personas en una solicitud de firma — firmantes, espectadores y cualquier persona copiada.
es.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Hacer una llamada API personalizada a un extremo específico
es.No Error on Failure: No hay ningún error en fallo
es.The ID of the document to retrieve. Alte:
El ID del documento a recuperar. Alternativamente, puede utilizar una de las siguientes palabras clave especiales:

combinado: Recupera todos los documentos como un único archivo PDF. Cuando el certificado de parámetro de consulta es verdadero, el certificado de finalización se incluye en el archivo PDF. Cuando el certificado de parámetro de consulta es falso, el certificado de finalización no está incluido en el archivo PDF.
archivo: Recupera un archivo ZIP que contiene todos los documentos PDF y el certificado de finalización.
certificado: Recupera sólo el certificado de finalización como un archivo PDF.
portafolio: Recupera los documentos del sobre como un portafolio PDF.
es.Subject line of the email sent to all re: Línea del asunto del correo electrónico enviado a todos los destinatarios.
es.Optional message body included in the si: Cuerpo de mensaje opcional incluido en el correo electrónico de la solicitud de firma.
Documentos a incluir en el sobre.
Los destinatarios que deben firmar el sobre.
es.Recipients who receive a copy of the com: Los destinatarios que reciben una copia del sobre completado pero no firman.
es.Required when operation is \"Void Envelo: Requerido cuando la operación es "Sobre del Vacío". Explicar por qué el sobre está siendo anulado.
es.Required when operation is \"Update Emai: Requerido cuando la operación es "Actualizar Asunto / Mensaje". Nueva línea de asunto para el correo electrónico firmante.
es.Used when operation is \"Update Email Su: Utilizado cuando la operación es "Actualizar Asunto / Mensaje". Nuevo texto de cuerpo para la firma del correo electrónico.
es.Full or partial name of the template to: Nombre completo o parcial de la plantilla a buscar.
es.Authorization headers are injected autom: Las cabeceras de autorización se inyectan automáticamente desde tu conexión.
Activar para archivos como PDFs, imágenes, etc.

es.Signing Email Sent to Person: Firmar correo electrónico enviado a la persona
es.Person Opened Signing Request: Solicitud de firma abierta de la persona
es.Person Failed Identity Check: No se pudo comprobar la identidad de la persona
es.Triggers when a new signing request (env: Dispara cuando se crea una nueva solicitud de firma (sobre) en DocuSign — ya sea enviada inmediatamente o guardada como un borrador.
es.Triggers when a signing request is email: Los desencadenantes cuando una solicitud de firma es enviada por correo electrónico a los destinatarios por primera vez.
es.Triggers when every recipient has opened: Dispara cuando cada destinatario ha abierto y visto la solicitud de firma al menos una vez.
es.Triggers when everyone has completed the: Dispara cuando todo el mundo ha completado su firma y el documento está completamente firmado.
es.Triggers when a recipient refuses to sig: Dispara cuando un destinatario se niega a firmar, deteniendo el proceso de firma.
es.Triggers when the sender cancels an in-p: Se activa cuando el remitente cancela una solicitud de firma en progreso antes de que todo el mundo haya firmado.
es.Triggers when DocuSign sends the signing: Dispara cuando DocuSign envía el correo electrónico de firma a una persona específica.
es.Triggers when a specific person opens an: Dispara cuando una persona específica abre y ve la solicitud de firma.
es.Triggers when a specific person complete: Desencadena cuando una persona concreta completa su firma en el documento.
es.Triggers when a specific person refuses: Dispara cuando una persona específica se niega a firmar el documento.
es.Triggers when a recipient fails the iden: Dispara cuando un destinatario falla el paso de verificación de identidad antes de firmar.

ja.The ID of the document to retrieve. Alte:
The ID of the document to retrieve. Alternatively, you can use one of the following special keywords:

combined: Retrieves all of the documents as a single PDF file. When the query parameter certificate is true, the certificate of completion is included in the PDF file. When the query parameter certificate is false, the certificate of completion is not included in the PDF file.
archive: Retrieves a ZIP archive that contains all of the PDF documents and the certificate of completion.
certificate: Retrieves only the certificate of completion as a PDF file.
portfolio: Retrieves the envelope documents as a PDF portfolio.

pt.Look up the full details of a signing re: Procure os detalhes completos de um pedido de assinatura — status, destinatários e datas — usando o seu ID.
pt.Download a document (or all documents) f: Baixar um documento (ou todos os documentos) de uma solicitação de assinatura como arquivo.
pt.Upload a document and send it to one or: Envie um documento e envie-o a uma ou mais pessoas para assinar via DocuSign.
pt.Send a draft, cancel, resend reminders,: Envie um rascunho, cancele, reenvie lembretes ou edite a linha do assunto em uma solicitação de assinatura.
pt.Search for reusable signing templates by: Procurar por modelos de assinatura reutilizáveis por nome.
pt.Get the full list of people on a signing: Obtenha a lista completa das pessoas em um pedido de assinatura — assinaturas, espectadores e qualquer um copiado.
pt.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Faça uma chamada de API personalizada para um ponto de extremidade específico
pt.The ID of the document to retrieve. Alte:
O ID do documento a recuperar. Como alternativa, você pode usar uma das seguintes palavras-chave especiais:

combinada: Recupera todos os documentos como um único arquivo PDF. Quando o certificado do parâmetro de consulta é verdadeiro, o certificado de conclusão é incluído no arquivo PDF. Quando o parâmetro de consulta certificado é falso, o certificado não é incluído no arquivo PDF.
arquivo: Obtém um arquivo ZIP que contém todos os documentos PDF e o certificado de conclusão.
certificado: Recupera apenas o certificado de conclusão em PDF.
portfólio: Recupera os documentos do envelope como um portfólio PDF.
pt.Subject line of the email sent to all re: Linha de assunto do e-mail enviado a todos os destinatários.
pt.Optional message body included in the si: Corpo da mensagem opcional incluído no e-mail da solicitação de assinatura.
Destinatários que devem assinar o envelope.
pt.Recipients who receive a copy of the com: Destinatários que recebem uma cópia do envelope concluído, mas não assinam.
pt.Required when operation is \"Void Envelo: Necessário quando a operação é "Envelope de Vazio". Explique por que o envelope está sendo anulado.
pt.Required when operation is \"Update Emai: Necessário quando a operação é "Atualizar Assunto do E-mail / Mensagem". Nova linha de assunto para a assinatura de e-mail.
pt.Used when operation is \"Update Email Su: Usado quando a operação é "Atualizar Assunto / Mensagem de e-mail". Novo texto do corpo para a assinatura do e-mail.
pt.Full or partial name of the template to: Nome completo ou parcial do modelo a procurar.
pt.Authorization headers are injected autom: Os cabeçalhos de autorização são inseridos automaticamente a partir da sua conexão.
Habilitar para arquivos como PDFs, imagens, etc.

pt.Signing Request Opened by All: Solicitação de assinatura aberta por Todos
pt.Signing Email Sent to Person: E-mail de assinatura enviado para pessoa

pt.Triggers when a new signing request (env: Aciona quando uma nova solicitação de assinatura (envelope) é criada no DocuSign — seja enviada imediatamente ou salva como rascunho.
pt.Triggers when a signing request is email: Aciona quando uma solicitação de assinatura é enviada por e-mail aos destinatários pela primeira vez.
pt.Triggers when every recipient has opened: Dispara quando cada destinatário abrir e ver a solicitação de assinatura pelo menos uma vez.
pt.Triggers when everyone has completed the: Aciona quando todos concluírem sua assinatura e o documento for totalmente assinado.
pt.Triggers when a recipient refuses to sig: Aciona quando um destinatário se recusa a assinar, interrompendo o processo de assinatura.
pt.Triggers when the sender cancels an in-p: Aciona quando o remetente cancela uma solicitação de assinatura em andamento antes de todos assinarem.
pt.Triggers when DocuSign sends the signing: Aciona quando o DocuSign envia o e-mail de assinatura para uma pessoa específica.
pt.Triggers when a specific person opens an: Dispara quando uma pessoa específica abre e visualiza a solicitação de assinatura.
pt.Triggers when a specific person complete: Aciona quando uma pessoa específica completa sua assinatura no documento.
pt.Triggers when a specific person refuses: Dispara quando uma pessoa específica se recusa a assinar o documento.
pt.Triggers when a recipient fails the iden: Aciona quando um destinatário falha na etapa de verificação de identidade antes da assinatura.
